subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be consolidated into the existing sub-agent prompt/tool-description surfaces, or should OpenClaw intentionally change nested sub-agent policy?
rationale: Current main already has multiple sub-agent guidance surfaces and supports configured nested spawning, so the right outcome depends on maintainer prompt-policy direction rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful non-duplicative examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and model-facing guidance together instead of changing prompt text alone.

options.title: Pause Or Close As Covered
options.body: If current main's merged guidance is sufficient, leave this branch paused or close it by maintainer decision rather than adding another prompt-policy source.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful non-duplicative examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision turns on nested sub-agent semantics introduced through the nested orchestration work.
